system.description:
CLASS TYPE Expert

You have learned that the most dangerous warrior is not always the strongest, but the one whose presence is not recognised until the killing blow has already fallen.

Ghostwalkers are masters of infiltration, misdirection and sudden violence. They train themselves to move without drawing the eye, to control their breathing and footfall, and to exploit the smallest lapse in an opponent’s attention. Some serve as scouts, spies or saboteurs, while others become bodyguards, assassins, thieves or agents trusted to enter places where an army could never tread.

Unlike Rogues, who rely upon versatility and opportunism, Ghostwalkers practise a specialised discipline of concealment and movement. They create their own openings, vanish before retaliation can find them and use unusual techniques collectively known as Ghost Arts.

Some Ghost Arts are entirely mundane: smoke, concealed weapons, climbing techniques and precise movement. Others cross into the supernatural, allowing experienced Ghostwalkers to fade from sight or pass between shadows.

You may want to play a Ghostwalker if you want to infiltrate guarded locations, move rapidly through dangerous terrain, deceive enemies and deliver deadly attacks before disappearing again.

MAGICAL TRADITION You have no normal spellcasting progression. At 1st level, select one magical tradition. If a Ghostwalker feat or Ghost Art grants you an innate spell or explicitly magical technique without specifying its tradition, it uses your selected tradition and Wisdom as your magical ability score. The Focus trait itself remains non-magical. Mundane Ghost Arts such as Ghost Step, Smoke Veil and Spider Path cannot be detected or dispelled as magic.
system.classSkills: Acrobatics, Athletics, Climbing, Crafting, Culture, Deception, Linguistics, Mental Focus, Perception, Sense Motive, Stealth, Survival, Thievery
system.classAbilities: 1: Ghostwalk, 1: Unseen Assault, 1: Vanishing Retreat, 1: Ghost Arts, 1: Magical Tradition
system.proficiencies: You are proficient with light armour and bucklers. You may use all simple weapons, shortbows and weapons with the Monastic trait. The wakizashi is considered a martial weapon for you rather than an exotic weapon.

trg-prime.bonusFeatsNote: At 1st level you gain the Weapon Finesse feat and may select any one additional class feat. At 3rd level and then every 3 levels thereafter you may select an additional class feat. You must meet the prerequisites or match the appropriate class traits (Expert or Ghostwalker) for these feats.
